title: Coverage Months of Rider Premium Reckoned as Owing Against a Withdrawn Ridgecrest Advantage Application
content:
The coverage months of rider premium reckoned as owing follow the state of the member's rider under the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders and the rider premium charged to its account, alongside their withdrawn Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan application.

- Where the member's optional supplemental benefit rider stands suspended for unpaid rider premium, the coverage months of rider premium reckoned as owing are 3.
- Where the member's optional supplemental benefit rider stands in force or in its waiting period and rider premium has been charged to its account in the last 6 months, they are 2.
- Where that rider stands in force or in its waiting period and no rider premium has been charged to its account in the last 6 months, where the rider stands in any state other than suspended for unpaid rider premium, in force or in its waiting period, or where the member holds no optional supplemental benefit rider, they are 1.

The third entry gathers three separate circumstances under one figure of 1: a rider in force or in its waiting period with no rider premium charged to its account inside the last 6 months, a rider standing in any other state at all, and a member with no rider.

| State of the rider | Rider premium charged to its account in the last 6 months | Coverage months reckoned as owing |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Suspended for unpaid rider premium | Any | 3 |
| In force, or in its waiting period | Yes | 2 |
| In force, or in its waiting period | No | 1 |
| Any other state | Any | 1 |
| No rider held | Not applicable | 1 |
